candidates: MemorySize: 128 for ThumbnailerFunction in the IaC template
Max Memory Used ~97-103 MB against a 128 MB limit (memory headroom)
answer.explanation: ThumbnailerFunction is configured at 128 MB while the other functions use 256 MB (CrudApi, Uploader) and 1024 MB (Compression). Its warm invocations take about 390-420 ms and its cold starts show Init Duration of 400-550 ms and total Duration of about 2.2 s. The Max Memory Used of 97-103 MB sits close to the 128 MB limit. Lambda allocates CPU in proportion to memory, so the undersized allocation plausibly causes the slow init and execution and the inflated billed durations. The logs are truncated (4469 events omitted), so the timeout, error and concurrency settings could not be checked. Confidence is moderate.
